summary: StudentPayHistory manages the history of payment-related attributes for students, including creation, viewing, updating, and deletion of pay history records tied to students. The module handles workflow for CRUD operations, field population, alternate display languages, and user attribution.
purpose: To track and manage detailed payment history for each student, including employment class, designation, status, pay level, year, and fixed-term appointments. It supports creation, updating, viewing, and deletion of pay history records.

workflows.name: Add StudentPayHistory
steps: Prepare parameters: StudentID, CreatedByUserID, EffectiveDate, EmploymentClassCodeID, DesignationCodeID, StatusCodeID, StatusReasonCodeID, PayLevelCodeID, PayLevelReasonCodeID, YearCodeID, FixedTermAppointmentCodeID, FixedTermAppointmentNotes

workflows.name: Update StudentPayHistory
steps: Prepare parameters: ID, EffectiveDate, EmploymentClassCodeID, DesignationCodeID, StatusCodeID, StatusReasonCodeID, PayLevelCodeID, PayLevelReasonCodeID, YearCodeID, FixedTermAppointmentCodeID, FixedTermAppointmentNotes

workflows.name: Search StudentPayHistory by Student
steps: Populate list via FillEntry from data reader

workflows.name: Search Most Recent StudentPayHistory
steps: If record found, populate via FillEntry; else, initialize entry with default/blank values

business_rules: If CreatedByUserID is 0, treat as Automated_process for display purposes.
In displays, use alternate language fields if UseAltLanguageFields is true.
If FixedTermAppointmentCodeID is 0, FixedTermAppointmentFormatted is blank.
StatusOrPayLevelReason returns StatusReason if available, otherwise PayLevelReason.
validations: All parameters must be provided and type-checked when adding or updating.
ID must be unique when adding; must exist when updating or deleting.
Date fields must be valid DateTime objects.
calculations: CreatedByUserLong and CreatedByUserShort are computed based on CreatedByUserID, FirstName, and LastName.
FixedTermAppointmentFormatted combines text and notes into a formatted string if applicable.
StatusOrPayLevelReason selects non-blank status or pay level reason.
conditions: Alternate language fields are used if UseAltLanguageFields is true in session.
If reading most recent entry and not found, default entry values to zeros and empty strings.
system_behavior: Uses stored procedures for all CRUD operations.
Closes data readers properly after operations.
Populates entity from SqlDataReader using FillEntry.
Handles missing records gracefully by returning default/empty entry.
exceptions: If an entry is not found during search, default fields are returned.
If parameters are not valid or missing, database operation may fail.
